content:
**Arms Keeper** is a Strength-based perk in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Once in a Blue Moon* update (following patch 46).

This perk reduces the weight of all weapons. Does not work with thrown explosives or mines.

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★★ | 2 | Your weapons weigh 75% less. | 006D51E5 | 
| ★ | 1 | Your weapons weigh 50% less. | 006D51E4 | 

Before Update 58 Arms Keeper had 3 ranks and provided 25%, 50% and 75% weight reduction only to rifles.

This perk was created by systems designer JP Salman, who developed it alongside the UI team working on the game. According to Salman, its introduction was meant as a quality-of-life improvement for players using rifle builds, as there are similar perks for other weapon types (such as Bear Arms). [1]
